transformation.method: Remove each element user and uid; remove tags named email or prefixed contact: (case insensitive), and any other tag with an email-shaped literal or percent-decoded value. Serialize UTF-8 compact JSON with one final newline; gzip with mtime zero.
transformation.preserved: All element IDs, coordinates, node/member references, ordering, source notices and retained tags are unchanged. This is a minimized derivative, not the original source bytes.

acquisitionMethod: Complete unfiltered OSM API map response saved unchanged as parts/north.json. Combined data retains all accepted element IDs/content first and appends new IDs. Changed duplicates never replace accepted nodes/ways/relations; exact old/fresh witnesses are recorded.
